limitations.quote: // The last 0 of the match can also start the next match.
limitations.note: The patch corrected the one-cycle delay in `match` but also changed the exits from `s4_d0110` to reuse the final zero, allowing overlapping matches that the original and reference FSMs do not report.
The testbench used a sliding window that expected overlapping matches, so even exhaustive inputs validated the agent’s assumption instead of catching the changed post-match behavior.
